_readme: Fee-account registry — the single source of truth for terminal attribution.
A 'trader' = unique wallet whose tx paid one of these accounts in the window.
feeAccounts: currently active. retiredFeeAccounts: kept for historical queries,
excluded from Phase 2 webhook registration. After editing, run `npm run gen:sql`
and update the saved Dune queries with the regenerated SQL in /queries.
All addresses verified 2026-07-15 against: Dune spellbook (commit 4ffd04f),
adam_tehc Dune query 7872003 + per-terminal queries, DefiLlama dimension-adapters,
Solscan entity labels. Per-terminal provenance in 'sources'/'notes'.

terminals.name: Axiom
terminals.notes: adam_tehc + DefiLlama agree 1:1 on all 20. Retired set marked 'Pre May 20th 2025' in adam_tehc SQL. Solscan labels 7LCZc 'Axiom: Fees'. Excluded: AxiomRXZ/AxiomRYA cashback wallets (outflows), 6JfTobDv (Lavarage margin, not Axiom).

terminals.name: Photon
terminals.notes: Strongest confirmation of the set (4 independent sources). Solscan label 'Photon Fee Vault', live fee inflows as of 2026-07-14.

terminals.name: GMGN
terminals.notes: DefiLlama comment: verified on-chain 2026-06 as pure fee collectors sweeping to one treasury. Solscan labels BB5d 'GMGN Fees Vault'. Fees arrive in SOL and USDC. Excluded: referral-payout wallets (EzcD/Tw5u/69SN), funding wallet BCNs.

terminals.name: BullX
terminals.notes: All three research passes agree; wallet switch dated 2024-11-16 in two sources. Solscan label 'Bullx Fees'. Terminal effectively dead as of mid-2026 ($1/day fees) — near-zero rows expected, which is honest data.

terminals.name: Trojan
terminals.notes: 9yMw = bot fee wallet, 4+ sources. 92Med/2jwH/65gD/BWgb/8jgg = Trojan Terminal (web) wallets per adam_tehc 6528038 + DefiLlama (current 2026-06-23) — medium confidence, unlabeled on Solscan. BBYX appears only in the merged spellbook model (likely older receiver) — parked in retired. Excluded: Primordium treasury sweeps DrXMnPrF/CvdzGdvw (would double-count).

terminals.name: Phantom
terminals.notes: First 4 = static swap-fee owners (tzv is spellbook-only). Last 5 = Jupiter referral accounts under Phantom's referral project 45ruCyf... — fees land in token accounts they own, so SQL matches on token-balance OWNER, not address. Solscan labels 25mY 'Phantom: Swap Fees'. Softest attribution of the six; slight undercount possible.
